skill.name: typescript-standards
skill.description: TypeScript coding standards for Oh My Brand! theme. Strict mode, interfaces, type definitions, classes, DOM manipulation, and patterns. Use when writing TypeScript components, utilities, or Web Components.

generated_query:
I'm working on the Oh My Brand! WordPress FSE theme and need to create a TypeScript class for a tabbed content component. The HTML structure is: ```html
Content 1
Content 2
``` Requirements: - Use strict TypeScript, strict mode enabled. - Define an interface `TabsOptions` with `activeTab?: string` (default first tab). - Create a `Tabs` class with a private readonly `#element` (container), private `#currentTab`, and proper readonly properties. - Use `#` prefix for private fields and arrow function methods for event handlers. - Type-safe DOM queries with `getElement` helper (or inline) and handle nulls with early returns. - Support `init()`, `switchTab(tabId: string)`, and `destroy()` methods. - Follow the naming conventions (PascalCase for class, camelCase for methods, SCREAMING_SNAKE for constants, etc.). Can you help me implement this class according to our project's TypeScript coding standards?
